svg.title: Runtime architecture of the beads-storage design: sessions, plugin scripts, the tracker CLI, the tracker port and projector in shared, the beads, files, fake, and later adapters, the bd CLI, the Dolt-in-git central store, file sources, the static index, and GitHub

g.title: client boundary: human roles, sessions, and the viewer
Engineer: approves gates and merges the pull request
CoBuilder session on clone A: architect and implement plugins
Second clone: a cloud or team session that runs bd sync
Viewer: static single-file HTML, unchanged
api boundary: plugin scripts of implement, architect, and artifact
State writers: implement and architect steps that call tracker.py to write state
implement:start and install: ask consent, then init the tracker
build_builds_view.py and verify_gate.py: read through the port
shared boundary: shared/tracker.py, shared/tracker_port/, and the shared scripts
tracker.py CLI: the one command agents call, taught by shared/tracker-usage.md. JSON out, exit 2 with no adapter
TrackerPort and TrackerRecord in shared/tracker: sync, claim_slice, pull request operations, and capabilities()
Projector: turns records into entities, joins, and the index
shared/build_index.py: reads through the port, writes the index
shared/beads_seed.py: seeds issues by external_ref, create-only
Contract test: one suite that every adapter must pass
adapters boundary: one adapter for each tracker
beads adapter: maps records to issues and the metadata.cb envelope
files adapter: reads today's files and refuses writes
fake adapter: in memory, proves the seam
linear and jira adapters: later programs, not built here
infra boundary: the bd binary
bd 1.3.0 CLI: master of programs, epics, slices, and pull request issues
data boundary: tracker stores, file sources, and the static index
Central store: proposed Dolt-in-git, hidden ref refs/dolt/data, not verified
Local .beads tracker: embedded Dolt, one per clone
docs/, .cobuilder/, and tracker.yaml: prose, plans, status, evidence, config
data/index.json: static read model
external boundary: GitHub and the later tracker APIs
GitHub: git remote that hosts refs/dolt/data, and the pull requests
Linear and Jira APIs: external trackers for later programs
Edges: every edge across a boundary carries its protocol
g.text: gh CLI: open PR, read merged state
sync on clone B: tracker.py sync, bd sync, git refs/dolt/data
